statement: Feeding trackers (Huckleberry, Nara) sell logging plus prediction-as-reassurance, and lactation-supplement brands (Legendairy Milk $45.99/180-cap, Milky Mama SKUs) sell herb stacks for supply; none provides adequacy assessment, IBCLC triage, or pump-misreading correction.
evidence: Huckleberry app listing (Premium $14.99/Plus $11.99); Nara tracker page (free/ad-free, 1M+ parents claimed); Legendairy Liquid Gold product page (1,040 mg/2 caps, try 7–10 days); Milky Mama headline ("Supplements to help increase breast milk production"). All accessed 2026-09-17.
